root_idea.summary: The root centers on contempt, lowliness, and reduced worth, with a related lexical branch concerning service and labor.
root_idea.development: Alongside the core sense of being held low or in contempt, the lexical family includes terms for service, a servant, and specialized uses involving pulling a garment and milking camels.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized classical citation form مَهِين rather than the internally marked QAC lemma spelling.

senses.definition: Held in contempt; lowly, abject, insignificant, or of little worth.
senses.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally and substantivally in the supplied Quran occurrences to characterize the referent as lowly or lacking worth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To use something for service or work; to put it to service.
To regard something as mean or of little account; to hold it in mean estimation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VIII verb; a derived evaluative use distinct from the adjective مَهِين.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Work, labor, or service; the ministration or performance of an office.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Noun denoting work, service, or the execution of an office.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Clothing worn in service or in the performance of business.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for service or business clothing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Weak; having little judgment and discrimination.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical descriptive use for weakness accompanied by deficient judgment or discernment.
Abstract noun for the state or quality of being held in low estimation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pull or tug a garment; a garment so treated is described as مَمْهُون.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported transitive use specifically involving a garment.
A separately reported transitive usage; the source presents it as an additional reported expression.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Covers the Form VIII service/work and mean-estimation branches.
Covers the noun sense of work, labor, service, and office performance.
Covers the service or business clothing sense.
Covers the contemptible/abject Quranic sense and the distinct Classical weakness and poor-judgment sense.

cautions: The QAC grouping combines three adjectival occurrences with one substantival occurrence; the public headword is normalized to مَهِين.

The weak and poor-judgment sense is retained as Classical Arabic coverage rather than folded into the Quranic low-worth sense, since the packet does not independently establish that specialization in a Quran occurrence.
